title: Opening: recording date and playing Punch his records
summary: Dick Allen announces the date and place, 1 Sept 1959 on St. Peter Street, and says they will play Punch his records to identify them.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places
story.community_name: Interview openings: names, dates and tape setup

blocks.x: We're recording this afternoon. This is September the 1st, 1959 at 818 St. Peter Street. And this is Dick Allen talking.
We're going to play Punch some of his records so he can tell us what's what about him.

This is a tiny firearm here Punch known as Blue Moon Blues. Now the other side is doing the Jug Jug. There's no personnel listed here. In some of the records it just says that you're featured. Now I'm just trying to see if you...
